intro.text: A noodle restaurant in Kilahito, renamed the Noodle Princess by its new owners.

description.text: It has tables and a bar whose wood is carved with heated round hollows that keep bowls of noodles warm. It also serves rice for soaking up the leftover broth. A bowl usually costs two hundred kon, and the owner gives discounts in prime-number percentages.
Many painters drop in after work or on their breaks.

items.text: Painters gathered here were recruited to help hold off an approaching army of nightmares.
When its founder left the planet, the shop passed to two of its regulars, who renamed it the Noodle Princess.
